steps.js: const t=document.body.innerText; const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('[class*=cand], [class*=bgm] li, [class*=bgm-c]')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0); const plays=[...document.querySelectorAll('.mp-play,.mp-big,.mp-audio button')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>0); const use=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>/用这一版/.test(b.innerText)).map(b=>({t:b.innerText.trim(), dis:b.disabled, title:b.title.slice(0,40)})); const srcs=[...document.querySelectorAll('audio')].map(a=>a.getAttribute('src')).filter(Boolean).map(s=>s.replace(/\?.*/,'')); return {epSelect:(t.match(/第 ?\d+ ?集/)||[null])[0], plays:plays.length, audioSrcs:srcs.slice(0,6), useButtons:use.slice(0,4), current:(t.match(/[^\n]*(当前|在用)[^\n]*/g)||[]).slice(0,3), failedShown:/没过|不合格/.test(t)};

const b=document.querySelector('.mp-audio .mp-big, .mp-play'); if(!b) return 'no player'; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); return [...document.querySelectorAll('audio')].filter(a=>!a.paused).map(a=>a.src.replace(/\?.*/,'').slice(-50)+'@'+a.currentTime.toFixed(1))
